claims.quote: The human brain relies on complex synaptic communication regulated by key genes such as SYNGAP1.

claims.quote: SYNGAP1 encodes the GTPase-Activating Protein (SYNGAP), a critical synaptic plasticity and neuronal excitability regulator.
Impaired SYNGAP1 function leads to neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs) characterized by intellectual disability (ID), epilepsy, and behavioral abnormalities.

claims.object_text: disrupt Ras signaling, altering AMPA receptor transport and synaptic plasticity
claims.quote: These variants disrupt Ras signaling, altering AMPA receptor transport and synaptic plasticity and contributing to cognitive and motor difficulties.
